{{Quote|Are you crazy? Pointing that thing at a Jedi? Put it down '''now'''!!|A Spaceport police droid to [[Loubo/Legends|Loubo]] after he picked up a frying pan|<ref name="Brothers">{{TCW|Brothers (episode)}}</ref>}}
'''Spaceport police droids''' were used as the [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] at various [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] such as the [[Stobar Spaceport/Legends|Stobar Spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Stobar/Legends|Stobar]] and in the [[Cybloc system/Legends|Cybloc system]].

==History==
Several of these [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were contacted in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] after [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] choked the waitress [[Sassi/Legends|Sassi]] in [[Plop Dribble's/Legends|Plop Dribble's]] spaceport [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]]. However, by the time the droids arrived, the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] had already fled. They were also used as security at a space station in the [[Cybloc system/Legends|Cybloc system]].
